Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: BluePeak is on a private deployment with customer-managed keys (BYOK) and we operate HSM-backed wrapping for tenant KEKs. We keep operator separation between "Crypto Operators" (key ceremonies, unwrapping/wrapping approvals) and "Platform Operators" (infra/service accounts) — details below.

I'll get the CSV and attestation to you by EOD Thursday; rotation log excerpts will be redacted as requested and delivered via the secure DocuSign/Drive link you prefer. We do not need an NDA for this set; the artifacts are covered under our SOC 2 evidence sharing process.

Answers to your questions:
- Separation of duties: Yes. Crypto Operators (2 persons per rotation window) are distinct from Platform Operators. Crypto Operators require multi-factor authentication and HSM physical presence gating for unseal operations when required by the tenant's configuration.
- Rotation cadence & retention: Tenant KEKs are rotated per-tenant on request or during emergency rotation. For standard ops we recommend annual KEK rotations and automated ephemeral CEKs at session level; rotation logs and operator approvals are retained for 24 months, with cryptographic audit traces retained for 7 years in cold storage (redactable summaries provided for audits).

I'll attach a concise operator matrix and our latest HSM attestation in the next message; looping in Laura from Trust Ops for the rotation-log extract.

Regards,
